transcript.message: Hi Dana, Blerim from Outsorcy. We help companies like Corvid scale their sales teams with world-class talent at a fraction of the cost. We're SOC 2 certified and we guarantee at least fifteen qualified meetings a month per SDR. Do you have a few minutes?
'Scale.' Meaning what? And certified? Send me the report and the auditor.
Absolutely, I'll send the certificate over. Meaning we provide dedicated SDRs who book meetings for you, guaranteed.
We touch PHI. Who clears your people?
We're fully certified, so that's covered. Can we set up a demo this week?
That's not what I asked. We're frozen until the round closes. I'm going to stop you there.
Okay, no problem, I'll send an email and try back next quarter.
